crossRefs.note: Moreover also I gave them statutes that were not good, and ordinances in which they should not live.
“This is what Yahweh says: ‘Behold, I will raise up evil against you out of your own house; and I will take your wives…
For you did this secretly, but I will do this thing before all Israel, and before the sun.’ ”
Yahweh said, ‘Who will entice Ahab, that he may go up and fall at Ramoth Gilead?’ One said one thing; and another said…
With him is strength and wisdom. The deceived and the deceiver are his.
But my people didn’t listen to my voice. Israel desired none of me.
So I let them go after the stubbornness of their hearts, that they might walk in their own counsels.
For you are our Father, though Abraham doesn’t know us, and Israel does not acknowledge us. You, Yahweh, are our…
I also will choose their delusions, and will bring their fears on them; because when I called, no one answered; when I…
Then I said, “Ah, Lord Yahweh! Surely you have greatly deceived this people and Jerusalem, saying, ‘You will have…
even he whose coming is according to the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders,
See therefore, I have stretched out my hand over you, and have diminished your portion, and delivered you to the will…
Therefore Yahweh’s anger burns against his people, and he has stretched out his hand against them and has struck them.…
The Syrians in front, and the Philistines behind; and they will devour Israel with open mouth. For all this, his anger…
Therefore the Lord will not rejoice over their young men, neither will he have compassion on their fatherless and…
Manasseh, Ephraim; and Ephraim, Manasseh; and they together shall be against Judah. For all this his anger is not…
They will only bow down under the prisoners, and will fall under the slain. For all this his anger is not turned away…

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: “ ‘ “If the prophet is deceived and speaks a word, I, Yahweh, have deceived that prophet, and I will stretch out my hand on him, and will destroy him from among my people Israel.
translations.bsb: But if the prophet is enticed to speak a message, then it was I the LORD who enticed him, and I will stretch out My hand against him and destroy him from among My people Israel.
translations.kjv: And if the prophet be deceived when he hath spoken a thing, I the LORD have deceived that prophet, and I will stretch out my hand upon him, and will destroy him from the midst of my people Israel.
translations.asv: And if the prophet be deceived and speak a word, I, Jehovah, have deceived that prophet, and I will stretch out my hand upon him, and will destroy him from the midst of my people Israel.
